_readme: Canonical Moodily sample registry. Every sample maps to an existing service id in services.json — prices are NEVER stored here, they are read from that one registry. sample_type must be one of: real-client, moodily-internal, self-initiated, concept. A concept sample is never presented as client work. 'image' = a real web-optimised asset under /assets/img/samples/. 'preview' = an inline-SVG concept preview key (build.py -> _sample_preview); concept previews add no files to the repo.
